import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    private static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    private static final double EPS = 1.0e-9;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        while (solve(scanner)) {
            // Continue processing multiple test cases
        }
    }

    private static boolean solve(Scanner scanner) {
        if (!scanner.hasNextLong()) {
            return false;
        }

        long p = scanner.nextLong();
        long k = scanner.nextLong();

        if (k == 0) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p - 1);
            System.out.println(ans);
            return true;
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p);
            System.out.println(ans);
            return true;
        }

        long[] used = new long[(int)p + 1];
        long ans = 1;

        for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
            if (used[(int)x] == 1) {
                continue;
            }

            ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
            used[(int)x] = 1;

            long v = x;
            while (used[(int)((v * k) % p)] == 0) {
                used[(int)((v * k) % p)] = 1;
                v = (v * k) % p;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        return true;
    }

    private static long fastPow(long a, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        long mask = 1;
        long powPart = a % MOD;

        final int bitsCount = 64;
        for (int i = 0; i < bitsCount; i++) {
            if ((p & mask) != 0) {
                res = (res * powPart) % MOD;
            }
            mask <<= 1;
            powPart = (powPart * powPart) % MOD;
        }

        return res;
    }
}
